      "keystrokes": "python3 - <<'PY'
import cv2, numpy as np
cap=cv2.VideoCapture('/app/example_video.mp4')
frames=[]
while True:
    ret, frame=cap.read()
    if not ret: break
    frames.append(frame)
cap.release()
print('total', len(frames))
bg_gray=cv2.cvtColor(frames[0], cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32)
for i, frame in enumerate(frames):
    gray=cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32)
    diff=np.abs(gray-bg_gray)
    mask=diff>25
    if mask.sum()>100:
        ys, xs=np.where(mask)
        y_min, y_max=int(ys.min()), int(ys.max())
        x_min, x_max=int(xs.min()), int(xs.max())
        cy=float(ys.mean())
        cx=float(xs.mean())
        print(f'{i:3d} pixels={int(mask.sum()):6d} y_min={y_min:4d} y_max={y_max:4d} cy={cy:7.1f} x_min={x_min:4d} x_max={x_max:4d} cx={cx:7.1f}')
    else:
        print(f'{i:3d} pixels={int(mask.sum()):6d} y_min=   -1 y_max=   -1 cy=    -1.0')
